**Research question:** *What are the emerging risk and protective factors for dementia in an ageing Aotearoa New Zealand population, and how might we identify them using population data?*

Work in your group. Short bullet points are fine. This worksheet becomes the skeleton of your final project plan.

## 1. Governance (after Module 1)

| Prompt | Your group's answer |
|:--|:----------------------|
| Which laws/codes apply to this health data? | |
| Which ethics approvals are needed (university / HDEC)? | |
| Who must be involved from a Māori data sovereignty / Te Tiriti perspective, and at what stage? | |
| One governance risk that could stop the project | |

## 2. Data (after Module 2)

| Prompt | Your group's answer |
|:--|:----------------------|
| Main data source(s) and why | |
| How will you *define* dementia in administrative data? (proxies, look-back window) | |
| Key exposures / protective factors and confounders | |
| Biggest data-quality or linkage concern (and who it affects most) | |

## 3. Algorithm (after Module 3)

| Prompt | Your group's answer |
|:--|:----------------------|
| Is the question predictive, causal, or both? Say why. | |
| Primary method (e.g. survival model; how will you treat death as a competing risk?) | |
| Would synthetic data help? For what purpose, and what would you check? | |
| Would you use XAI? What can and can't it tell you here? | |

## 4. Platform (after Module 4)

| Prompt | Your group's answer |
|:--|:----------------------|
| Where does the analysis happen (e.g. secure Data Lab)? | |
| How will you manage code, versions and reproducibility there? | |
| How will results leave the secure environment? | |
| Biggest practical delivery risk | |
